qualification.details: State Programme Manager- SPM NAM: Graduation degree in any discipline including AYUSH and MBA in Healthcare Management/Human Resource (HR) Management or HR as one of the subject/ Masters in Health/Hospital administration/Post Graduate Diploma in Hospital & Health care management (Two years) from AICTE recognized institute. Yoga Instructor- Part Time: 10+2 pass with Yoga Wellness Instructor Course Certificate by Yoga Certification Board OR 10+2 pass with Diploma in Yoga from recognized University Institute of repute.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AN AYUSH Society recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the AN AYUSH Society recruitment is 10 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the AN AYUSH Society recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced by the Andaman & Nicobar AYUSH Society for various posts, including State Programme Manager, MO-cum-CHO (Homeopathy), and Yoga Instructor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it out, and send it to the official address as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts announced by AN AYUSH Society is 45 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per the norms of the A&N Administration.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for AN AYUSH Society recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary for each post. They range from a Graduation degree in AYUSH and MBA in Healthcare Management to a degree in Homoeopathy and a 10+2 pass with a Yoga certificate or diploma.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the AN AYUSH Society recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the AN AYUSH Society recruitment will be based on an Interview and a Merit List. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for the recruited candidates?
faq.answer: The salary structure varies per post. The State Programme Manager can earn up to Rs. 55,000/- p.m., MO-cum-CHO (Homeopathy) up to Rs. 40,000/- p.m., and Yoga Instructor (Part Time) up to Rs. 10,000/- p.m.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the Andaman & Nicobar Islands, specifically in Sri Vijaya Puram, with the pincode 744103.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as a photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational and experience certificates with the application form.
